The decree stands third in the sequence the same book prints, and its own text
gives the reason for a new edition: at the beginning of the third millennium it
seemed good to prepare a new edition of the Roman Missal which should take in
the more recent documents of the Apostolic See and above all the new Code of
Canon Law. The printing-history leaf, read here, orders the three editions and
the reprint.
